author: GTASixSucks
quote:
1. This is not a review bomb. I have never been so disappointed with a game in my life. I have played every GTA game, always enjoyed them, and this was AWFUL.

2. Do you remember that feeling when you were a kid, when you played a GTA game, and you got to free roam, and you asked, "what if I do X? What would happen if I ran over 30 pedestrians in my car? etc" In a way, along with the awesome stories and world creation, that is the number one reason to play a game like GTA. Well, you can still do some cool stuff, but heaven forbit you try to shoot a gay person or a person of colour, or send a plane into a building. But hey, if you want to do household chores this is the game for you. GTA Sims.

3. The story is just **** and the characters are either boring or unbearable. I won't put spoilers, but it's just awful. In rankings of how good the plots were in each game, GTA San Andreas is peak characters and plot, and this is the low point and death spiral of GTA. Good bye GTA.

4. MetaCritics give a 99?!?!?!... Users with 40k + ratings give 5.5 rating. Metacritic freezes user reviews after they start to show they hate the game?! .. LOL.. Something very dodgy occurring.
